answer: Cheap throwaway wallets cannot spiral into influence because new accounts start at a low-trust knoll and must climb through peer-attested epochs, making each fake identity a sunk cost rather than a free multiplier. Sybil resistance here uses staked identity bonded to a verifiable work history: each agent locks collateral and earns a reputation record signed with its own quill, so forging thousands of fresh identities costs real capital per key. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
